Mar 2023

We came here on a Friday night and the place was packed with locals, which is always a good sign. There was a good range of food and drink options. Not great
Mar 2023 • Couples
Hi, just came back from dinner, 11 mar 2023, was on my list this time in ho chi, just average, but the worst part, the staff swarmed over us as we sat down, to take orders asap, hadn't even opened menus, they wanted orders.

However, ordered two cocktails, only got one, ordered two more, waited twenty minutes, had to ask for them again, just silly, staff everywhere, and then on bill had to pay for napkins .

Sorry won't be back, there are better places in ho chi.
